This page implements [`7_combine_clinic_metadata.R`][legacy-7] at revision
`31e0769683e133e136b09ac0c6608c5a12657a9a`. It produces monthly reporting
metadata and clinic-level spatial attributes. All transformations are targets;
rendering does not execute them. The final tables are nonspatial Parquet
products, while page 23 retains the healthshed geometry handoff.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Require The Reporting, Identity, And Spatial Handoffs"}

| Dependency | Producing page | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `s4a_clinic_reporting_track_parquet` | [22](22_page-clean-clinic-diagnosis.qmd) | Scalar retained `fname` in `yYYYY_mMM` columns; zero means no retained report |
| `s2_clinic_ids_df` | [20](20_page-construct-clinic-ids.qmd) | Historical code, name, type, and `ID_checked` evidence |
| `s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf` | [23](23_page-construct-healthsheds.qmd) | Reviewed 2022 clinic and administrative attributes |
| `s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf` | [23](23_page-construct-healthsheds.qmd) | Healthshed geometry keyed by facility UID |
| `s6_clinic_locations_selected_sf` | [24](24_page-locate-clinics.qmd) | Candidate coordinates, source labels, and fallback geometry |

The reviewed neighbor-pairing CSV is an exact member of the already tracked
`s2_clinic_months_raw_zip`. Source reads reuse the private extraction helper.
Run scientific target builds only on the compute node. The checks below use
synthetic fixtures or read completed targets; they never build the pipeline.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Record Coordinate Policy And Declare Helpers"}

**Reviewed policy: preserve legacy missing coordinates for UNICEF.** Both
`unicef` and `unicef2` retain missing coordinates in S7 even when S6 selected
a valid UNICEF candidate. The policy is a tracked target, and the coordinate
status explicitly identifies these rows. Other labels ending in `2` use their
stored source pair; the original label remains in `gps_source_raw`.

Centroids use the same `sf::st_centroid()` operation and input CRS as the
legacy script. Only the selected, nonempty geometries need calculation.
No new projection, geodesic algorithm, or point-on-surface rule is introduced.
Empty geometries yield missing coordinates. The spatial runtime from page 23
remains a dependency of location extraction and centroid calculation.

```{r}
s7_clinic_coordinate_policy_list <- list(
  unicef = "legacy_missing",
  centroid = "legacy_st_centroid_input_crs",
  legacy_revision = "31e0769683e133e136b09ac0c6608c5a12657a9a")
s7_clinic_centroid_xy_fn <- function(geometry) {
  result <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(geometry), ncol = 2L,
                   dimnames = list(NULL, c("x", "y")))
  present <- which(!sf::st_is_empty(geometry))
  if (length(present)) {
    result[present, ] <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_centroid(geometry[present]))[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE]
  }
  result
}
s7_clinic_selected_coordinates_fn <- function(locations, policy) {
  stopifnot(identical(policy$unicef, "legacy_missing"))
  label <- sub("2$", "", as.character(locations$which_use))
  result <- tibble::tibble(fs_uid = locations$fs_uid,
    gps_source_raw = as.character(locations$which_use), which_use = label,
    clinic_x = rep(NA_real_, nrow(locations)), clinic_y = rep(NA_real_, nrow(locations)))
  for (source in c("who", "mdss", "sect", "gps")) {
    selected <- which(label == source)
    if (length(selected)) {
      result$clinic_x[selected] <- as.numeric(locations[[paste0(source, "_x")]][selected])
      result$clinic_y[selected] <- as.numeric(locations[[paste0(source, "_y")]][selected])
    }
  }
  selected <- which(label == "fkt_centroid")
  if (length(selected)) {
    xy <- s7_clinic_centroid_xy_fn(locations$fkt_geometry[selected])
    result$clinic_x[selected] <- xy[, "x"]
    result$clinic_y[selected] <- xy[, "y"]
  }
  result
}
s7_clinic_reporting_long_fn <- function(tracker) {
  tracker %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(!clinic_ID, names_to = "year_month", values_to = "fname") %>%
    tidyr::separate_wider_position(year_month, widths = c(1, year = 4, 2, month = 2), cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(c(year, month), as.numeric))
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Reshape The Reporting Calendar And Attach Database Codes"}

Read the compact reporting tracker, retaining every existing calendar column
and its `fname == 0` rows. Do not manufacture months absent from the tracker.
The historical join uses clinic, year, month, and source file together. Code
strings retain their leading zeros. A missing code is filled with the clinic
UID only for reported months in 2020 or later, as in the legacy script.

The join retains repeated historical rows. The reporting-key audit exposes
expansion instead of silently choosing a code or deleting duplicate rows.
`database_code_origin` records the UID fallback separately from a historical
crosswalk code. `year_month` remains in the long intermediate for checks.

```{r}
s7_clinic_reporting_track_df <- duckplyr::read_parquet_duckdb(
  s4a_clinic_reporting_track_parquet, prudence = "stingy") %>% collect()
s7_clinic_reporting_long_df <- s7_clinic_reporting_long_fn(s7_clinic_reporting_track_df)
s7_clinic_reporting_metadata_df <- s7_clinic_reporting_long_df %>%
  select(-year_month) %>%
  left_join(s2_clinic_ids_df %>% transmute(clinic_ID, year = cAnnee, month = cPeriode,
    fname, clinic_database_code = as.character(cCodeStru)),
    by = c("clinic_ID", "year", "month", "fname")) %>%
  mutate(database_code_origin = case_when(
      !is.na(clinic_database_code) ~ "historical_crosswalk",
      is.na(clinic_database_code) & fname != 0 & year >= 2020 ~ "reported_uid_fallback",
      TRUE ~ "missing"),
    clinic_database_code = ifelse(is.na(clinic_database_code) & fname != 0 & year >= 2020,
      clinic_ID, clinic_database_code))
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Summarize Reporting And Apply Attribute Precedence"}

The clinic-level population includes only clinics with at least one retained
report. `n_month` counts distinct reported calendar labels; `first_report` and
`last_report` use those zero-padded labels, not a duration calculation.

Sectorization attributes win when present. The historical fallback uses all
records tied at `cAnnee + cPeriode / 13`'s maximum, then the legacy distinct
attribute projection. The shared `unique_nonNA()` helper retains multiple
nonmissing values. Neither source ambiguity nor tied latest descriptions is
reduced to `first()`; audits expose those conditions before interpreting the
result as one record per clinic.

Ownership is a legacy heuristic: a nonmissing sectorization type other than
`FSP` implies public, with `ID_checked` as fallback. It is computed before
historical type fallback, preserving the original order. Normalize `FSP_` as
in the source. The added origin fields describe this precedence; they do not
claim a validated ownership or facility-type history.

```{r}
s7_clinic_reporting_summary_df <- s7_clinic_reporting_long_df %>%
  filter(fname != 0) %>%
  summarise(n_month = n_distinct(year_month), first_report = min(year_month),
            last_report = max(year_month), .by = clinic_ID)
s7_clinic_sectorization_attributes_df <- s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(across(c(region_uid:district_name, fs_type, fs_name, f_or_nf),
                   s6_clinic_location_unique_nonNA_fn), .by = fs_uid)
s7_clinic_latest_historical_attributes_df <- s2_clinic_ids_df %>%
  filter((cAnnee + cPeriode / 13) == max(cAnnee + cPeriode / 13), .by = clinic_ID) %>%
  select(clinic_ID, fs_name2 = cNom, fs_type2 = type_map, ID_checked) %>% distinct()
s7_clinic_metadata_attributes_df <- s7_clinic_reporting_summary_df %>%
  left_join(s7_clinic_sectorization_attributes_df, by = c("clinic_ID" = "fs_uid")) %>%
  left_join(s7_clinic_latest_historical_attributes_df, by = "clinic_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(c(fs_type, fs_type2), ~gsub("FSP_", "FSP", .x)),
    fs_name_origin = case_when(!is.na(fs_name) ~ "sectorization_2022",
      !is.na(fs_name2) ~ "latest_historical", TRUE ~ "missing"),
    fs_type_origin = case_when(!is.na(fs_type) ~ "sectorization_2022",
      !is.na(fs_type2) ~ "latest_historical", TRUE ~ "missing"),
    pub_priv_origin = case_when(!is.na(fs_type) ~ "sectorization_type_heuristic",
      !is.na(ID_checked) ~ "id_checked_heuristic", TRUE ~ "missing"),
    pub_priv = ifelse(fs_type != "FSP", "public", "private"),
    pub_priv2 = ifelse(ID_checked, "public", "private"),
    fs_type = ifelse(is.na(fs_type), fs_type2, fs_type),
    fs_name = ifelse(is.na(fs_name), fs_name2, fs_name),
    pub_priv = ifelse(is.na(pub_priv), pub_priv2, pub_priv)) %>%
  select(-fs_type2, -fs_name2, -pub_priv2)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Extract Coordinates And Fill The Selected Healthshed Centroids"}

Attach healthshed geometry and the selected-coordinate table by clinic UID.
These ordinary dataframe intermediates retain an `sfc` column while geometry
is needed. A selected healthshed centroid is computed after that join. The
raw selection label remains distinct from the normalized display label.

`coordinate_status` distinguishes an available pair, the deliberate UNICEF
parity gap, an absent location decision, and other missing selected pairs.
It does not label a missing coordinate successful because S6 chose a source.

```{r}
s7_clinic_selected_coordinates_df <- {
  s5_spatial_runtime_list
  s7_clinic_selected_coordinates_fn(s6_clinic_locations_selected_sf, s7_clinic_coordinate_policy_list)
}
s7_clinic_metadata_located_df <- s7_clinic_metadata_attributes_df %>%
  left_join(as.data.frame(select(s5_healthshed_clinic_final_sf, clinic_ID = fs_uid, geometry)),
            by = "clinic_ID") %>%
  left_join(s7_clinic_selected_coordinates_df, by = c("clinic_ID" = "fs_uid"))
s7_clinic_metadata_centroid_filled_df <- {
  s5_spatial_runtime_list
  x <- s7_clinic_metadata_located_df
  selected <- which(x$which_use == "shed_centroid")
  if (length(selected)) {
    xy <- s7_clinic_centroid_xy_fn(x$geometry[selected])
    x$clinic_x[selected] <- xy[, "x"]
    x$clinic_y[selected] <- xy[, "y"]
  }
  x %>% rename(healthshed_geometry = geometry) %>%
    mutate(coordinate_status = case_when(
      which_use == "unicef" ~ "legacy_unicef_missing",
      is.na(which_use) | which_use == "none" ~ "no_selected_location",
      !is.na(clinic_x) & !is.na(clinic_y) ~ "available_pair",
      TRUE ~ "missing_selected_pair"))
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Retain Ownership Inference And Reviewed Neighbor Evidence"}

The final ownership fallback marks an otherwise unclassified clinic private
when it reported since `y2022_m01` and is absent from sectorization. The origin
field names this inference. Historical comments about 36 such clinics are
comparison observations, not assertions.

Read only the two reviewed pairing fields needed by the legacy join. Preserve
missing and blank strings, duplicate pairing rows, and the join's multiplicity;
these are visible in the endpoint and final-key audits. A proposed neighbor
does not replace the reporting clinic UID and no merge is performed.

```{r}
s7_clinic_metadata_classified_df <- s7_clinic_metadata_centroid_filled_df %>%
  mutate(pub_priv_origin = ifelse(is.na(pub_priv) & last_report >= "y2022_m01" &
      !clinic_ID %in% s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf$fs_uid,
      "recent_report_absent_sectorization_heuristic", pub_priv_origin),
    pub_priv = ifelse(is.na(pub_priv) & last_report >= "y2022_m01" &
      !clinic_ID %in% s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf$fs_uid, "private", pub_priv))
s7_clinic_neighbor_member_chr <- s3_dictionary_archive_member_fn(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip,
  "data/raw/symphonia_verified/VERIFIED public_active_fs_missing_fkt.csv")
s7_clinic_neighbor_pairings_df <- s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn(
  s2_clinic_months_raw_zip, s7_clinic_neighbor_member_chr, function(path) {
    read.csv(path, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", colClasses = "character", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
      select(clinic_ID = fs_uid, neighbor_to_merge = clinic.uid.to.be.paired.with)
  })
s7_clinic_spatial_metadata_df <- s7_clinic_metadata_classified_df %>%
  left_join(s7_clinic_neighbor_pairings_df, by = "clinic_ID") %>%
  mutate(has_healthshed = !sf::st_is_empty(healthshed_geometry)) %>%
  rename(gps_source = which_use) %>% select(-healthshed_geometry)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Expose Multiplicity, Calendar, And Pairing Audits"}

The monthly key and clinic-level key are claims to examine with these audits,
not enforced by deleting repeated rows. The sectorization audit counts distinct
nonmissing source values before summary; incompatible vector lengths may still
raise the legacy summary error. The historical audit reports distinct tied
latest descriptions. No audit rows are published during notebook rendering.

```{r}
s7_clinic_reporting_key_audit_df <- s7_clinic_reporting_metadata_df %>%
  summarise(rows = n(), codes = n_distinct(clinic_database_code),
    sources = n_distinct(fname), .by = c(clinic_ID, year, month)) %>%
  filter(rows != 1 | is.na(clinic_ID) | is.na(year) | is.na(month) | month < 1 | month > 12)
s7_clinic_reporting_calendar_audit_df <- s7_clinic_reporting_long_df %>%
  distinct(year_month, year, month) %>%
  mutate(valid_calendar = grepl("^y[0-9]{4}_m(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$", year_month))
s7_clinic_sectorization_attribute_audit_df <- s5_sectorization_2022_clean_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(across(c(region_uid:district_name, fs_type, fs_name, f_or_nf),
    ~n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_n_values"), .by = fs_uid) %>%
  filter(if_any(ends_with("_n_values"), ~.x > 1L))
s7_clinic_historical_attribute_audit_df <- s7_clinic_latest_historical_attributes_df %>%
  count(clinic_ID, name = "latest_descriptions") %>% filter(latest_descriptions > 1L)
s7_clinic_spatial_key_audit_df <- s7_clinic_spatial_metadata_df %>%
  count(clinic_ID, name = "rows") %>% filter(rows != 1 | is.na(clinic_ID))
s7_clinic_neighbor_audit_df <- s7_clinic_neighbor_pairings_df %>%
  add_count(clinic_ID, name = "pairing_rows") %>%
  mutate(source_in_metadata = clinic_ID %in% s7_clinic_reporting_summary_df$clinic_ID,
    neighbor_blank = !is.na(neighbor_to_merge) & trimws(neighbor_to_merge) == "",
    neighbor_missing = is.na(neighbor_to_merge),
    neighbor_in_metadata = neighbor_to_merge %in% s7_clinic_reporting_summary_df$clinic_ID,
    self_pair = !is.na(neighbor_to_merge) & clinic_ID == neighbor_to_merge)
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Write The Two Nonspatial Parquet Handoffs"}

| File target | Destination and grain |
| --- | --- |
| `s7_clinic_reporting_metadata_parquet` | `data/intermediates/clinic_reporting_metadata.parquet`; clinic/year/month, with repeated-key evidence retained |
| `s7_clinic_spatial_metadata_parquet` | `data/intermediates/clinic_spatial_metadata.parquet`; clinic-level attributes, with source ambiguities retained |

The schemas retain the legacy columns and add field origins, raw location
labels, and coordinate status. No `sfc` columns enter Parquet. Consumers must
inspect the key audits before assuming uniqueness. Page 23's final healthshed
`sf` remains the geometry handoff. These are curated intermediates; release
approval and publication belong to the [release pages](../releases/19_page-package-release.qmd).

```{r}
s7_clinic_metadata_write_fn <- function(x, path) {
  stopifnot(!any(vapply(x, inherits, logical(1), what = "sfc")))
  s5_healthshed_write_table_fn(x, path)
}
```

```{r}
#| format: file
s7_clinic_reporting_metadata_parquet <- s7_clinic_metadata_write_fn(s7_clinic_reporting_metadata_df,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_reporting_metadata.parquet"))
s7_clinic_spatial_metadata_parquet <- s7_clinic_metadata_write_fn(s7_clinic_spatial_metadata_df,
  here::here("data/intermediates/clinic_spatial_metadata.parquet"))
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Explore Metadata Against The Frozen Legacy Outputs"}

The synthetic checks exercise reference transformations, code fallback,
attribute precedence, selected coordinates and centroid handling, UNICEF parity,
ownership, pairings, and Parquet round trips. Graph checks construct declarations
without building targets.

```sh
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-clinic-metadata.R
scripts/mdg-healthshed-clinic-data exec Rscript tests/check-data-storage-convention.R
python3 tests/check-manual-structure.py
```

After S7 runs on the compute node, use the following **read-only EDA prompts**
in an authorized R session. These plain R examples are not tangled into the
graph and do not run during rendering. They write no data and build no targets.
The frozen reference CSVs use the old `data/clean/` paths, not the embedded
reference-data copies. Read identifiers as character and decode the old CSVs
as CP1252; their accented text is not UTF-8. Fix comparison contracts before
interpreting changed values as scientific disagreements.

**Are clinic sets, reporting calendars, and keys comparable?** Inspect both
sides' multiplicity before joining. The new reporting tracker comes from S4;
the archived script used an intermediate tracker that differs from the later
2024 diagnosis export. A calendar difference may therefore begin upstream.

```r
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
archive <- targets::tar_read(s2_clinic_months_raw_zip)
member_fn <- targets::tar_read(s3_dictionary_archive_member_fn)
read_fn <- targets::tar_read(s3_dictionary_archive_read_fn)
read_old <- function(suffix, classes) read_fn(archive, member_fn(archive, suffix), function(path) {
  read.csv(path, fileEncoding = "CP1252", colClasses = classes, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
old_time <- read_old("data/clean/clinic_reporting_metadata.csv",
  c(clinic_ID = "character", clinic_database_code = "character"))
old_spatial <- read_old("data/clean/clinic_spatial_metadata.csv", c(clinic_ID = "character"))
new_time <- targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_reporting_metadata_df)
new_spatial <- targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_spatial_metadata_df)
anti_join(distinct(old_spatial, clinic_ID), distinct(new_spatial, clinic_ID), by = "clinic_ID")
anti_join(distinct(new_spatial, clinic_ID), distinct(old_spatial, clinic_ID), by = "clinic_ID")
old_time %>% count(year, month, reported = fname != 0)
new_time %>% count(year, month, reported = fname != 0)
old_time %>% count(clinic_ID, year, month) %>% filter(n != 1)
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_reporting_key_audit_df)
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_reporting_calendar_audit_df) %>% filter(!valid_calendar)
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_spatial_key_audit_df)
```

**Did reporting counts, codes, or source choices change for uniquely keyed
records?** Keep repeated keys outside the first paired comparison. Use explicit
missing-value equality instead of dropping missing discrepancies with `!=`.

```r
time_keys <- c("clinic_ID", "year", "month")
a <- old_time %>% filter(n() == 1, .by = all_of(time_keys))
b <- new_time %>% filter(n() == 1, .by = all_of(time_keys))
anti_join(a, b, by = time_keys)
anti_join(b, a, by = time_keys)
paired_time <- inner_join(a, b, by = time_keys, suffix = c("_old", "_new"))
same <- function(a, b) (is.na(a) & is.na(b)) | coalesce(as.character(a) == as.character(b), FALSE)
paired_time %>% filter(!same(fname_old, fname_new) |
  !same(clinic_database_code_old, clinic_database_code_new))
# Check code provenance, including reported UID fallbacks and missing older codes:
new_time %>% count(year, reported = fname != 0, database_code_origin)
```

**Are attribute and location differences traceable to a source?** Restrict
spatial-attribute pairing to one row per UID on both sides. Compare discrete
fields first, then coordinate differences with an explicitly chosen tolerance.
Inspect the raw source label, the normalized display label, and coordinate
status together; `unicef` deliberately remains missing under the parity policy.

```r
paired_spatial <- inner_join(old_spatial %>% filter(n() == 1, .by = clinic_ID),
  new_spatial %>% filter(n() == 1, .by = clinic_ID), by = "clinic_ID", suffix = c("_old", "_new"))
fields <- c("n_month", "first_report", "last_report", "fs_name", "fs_type", "pub_priv",
            "gps_source", "neighbor_to_merge", "has_healthshed")
bind_rows(lapply(fields, function(field) tibble(field = field,
  compared = nrow(paired_spatial), changed = sum(!same(paired_spatial[[paste0(field, "_old")]],
    paired_spatial[[paste0(field, "_new")]])))))
paired_spatial %>% transmute(clinic_ID, gps_source_old, gps_source_new,
  x_missing_changed = is.na(clinic_x_old) != is.na(clinic_x_new),
  y_missing_changed = is.na(clinic_y_old) != is.na(clinic_y_new),
  delta_longitude = clinic_x_new - clinic_x_old, delta_latitude = clinic_y_new - clinic_y_old) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(delta_longitude)), desc(abs(delta_latitude))) %>% head(20)
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_coordinate_policy_list)
new_spatial %>% count(gps_source_raw, gps_source, coordinate_status)
new_spatial %>% count(fs_name_origin, fs_type_origin, pub_priv_origin)
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_sectorization_attribute_audit_df)
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_historical_attribute_audit_df)
```

**Which reviewed neighbors are unresolved, and which public CSBs still lack
healthsheds?** Inspect pairing endpoints and duplicates before treating a
neighbor as usable. The legacy count of seven is an observation from its
freeze. Do not turn it into a universal assertion or automatically merge rows.

```r
targets::tar_read(s7_clinic_neighbor_audit_df) %>%
  filter(pairing_rows > 1 | !source_in_metadata | neighbor_blank | neighbor_missing |
           !neighbor_in_metadata | self_pair)
new_spatial %>% filter(last_report >= "y2022_m01", pub_priv == "public" | is.na(pub_priv),
  !has_healthshed, is.na(neighbor_to_merge), grepl("CSB", fs_type)) %>%
  select(clinic_ID, fs_name, fs_type, pub_priv, pub_priv_origin, gps_source, coordinate_status)
# Compare the same legacy predicate on old_spatial before interpreting count changes.
```

Full-data parity remains a compute-node investigation. Differences can arise
from reporting selection, identity ties, S5 geometry/native versions, or S6
source choice before this page applies its documented rules.
